<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2 - Territory War 20260916</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <script src="scripts.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    // Game initialization
    const game = {
      territory: {
        occupied: [],
        expanding: false,
        currentTurn: 0,
        turnCount: 0,
        map: {
          width: 10,
          height: 10,
          grid: []
        }
      },
      players: [
        { id: 1, name: "Player 1", color: "red" },
        { id: 2, name: "Player 2", color: "blue" }
      ],
      ai: {
        player1: {
          name: "AI Player 1",
          color: "red",
          strategy: "basic"
        },
        player2: {
          name: "AI Player 2",
          color: "blue",
          strategy: "advanced"
        }
      }
    };

    // Game logic
    function initGame() {
      // Initialize game map
      game.territory.map.grid = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < game.territory.map.width; i++) {
        game.territory.map.grid[i] = [];
        for (let j = 0; j < game.territory.map.height; j++) {
          game.territory.map.grid[i][j] = { occupied: false, color: "white" };
        }
      }

      // Initialize player positions
      game.territory.occupied = [
        { player: 1, position: { x: 0, y: 0 } },
        { player: 2, position: { x: 9, y: 9 } }
      ];

      // Start game
      game.territory.expanding = true;
      game.territory.currentTurn = 0;
      game.territory.turnCount = 0;
    }

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
      if (game.territory.expanding) {
        // Expand territory
        game.territory.occupied[0].position = {
          x: game.territory.occupied[0].position.x + 1,
          y: game.territory.occupied[0].position.y
        };
        game.territory.turnCount++;
      } else {
        // Check for win condition
        if (game.territory.occupied[0].position.x === game.territory.map.width - 1 &&
            game.territory.occupied[0].position.y === game.territory.map.height - 1) {
          alert("Player 1 wins!");
          game.territory.expanding = false;
        }
      }
    }

    // Start game
    initGame();
    gameLoop();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
